data.name: Devlen
data.long_meaning: Devlen is derived from the Old English word 'devlan', meaning 'dark one'. In Celtic mythology, Devlin was a god of darkness and the underworld. In Christian context, the name can represent a strong and mysterious figure, full of depth and intrigue.
